replies.body:
It looks like you have been evading your ban with this account. Ban evasion is defined as using a different Minecraft account to access the server, while you have a ban active on another account. From this, and the fact and it's only been 2 months (hacking bans typically take longer to appeal -- 6 months), you will not be appealed.

Regards,
ViceWatercolour.
